scope: Public-download acceptance only; package contents, producer attempt binding, native tests, validator payloads and listening remain independent gates.
metadata_authenticity: Artifact entries fetched using the authenticated GitHub workflow-artifacts connector; original run JSON fetched using the GitHub repository fetch connector. Retained source snapshots remain required inputs.

artifacts.separate_content_gate: Actual archive must qualify with 225 WAV files / 89 programs / 46 folders; source configuration is not an archive result.

acceptance_requirements: Use exactly these five source-bound artifact names and distinct actual artifact IDs; no replacement with test/validator/debug artifacts.
Acquire authentic artifact/run metadata; verify repository IDs, full source SHA, run ID and attempt context.
Bind each artifact to its original upload and producer attempt through original job logs as a separate gate; artifact API alone lacks producing attempt.
Reject expired artifacts or expiry timestamps at/before observation; calculate minimum only after all five authentic entries exist.
Use the unchanged parameterized probe for a new complete unauthenticated GET of each nightly.link artifact route. Never supply Authorization, Cookie or Range.
Require HTTP 200 without Content-Range; actual full body bytes and SHA256 must equal the authenticated API size and digest. Reject login/error/wrong/truncated bodies.
Retain only sanitized redirect endpoints with query_redacted; never retain presigned URL queries, cookies or tokens.
Require five successful new receipts bound to their exact API input hashes before marking aggregate public_downloads_qualified.
Report minimum expires_at across all five in UTC and America/Halifax. These are expiring Actions artifacts, not permanent release assets.
Keep release_qualified false here; overall native, packaging, payload binding, audition and final publication gates are external.
